'''Jodaka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Jodaka system/Legends|Jodaka system]], within the [[Corsair Outback]] area in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], a remote region in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions<ref name="Region" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The vast [[Salt/Legends|saltwater]] [[Water/Legends|seas]] of Jodaka were home to many strange yet deadly creatures, including the [[Jodakan needler crab]], a deceptive and dangerous [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet's surface was also composed of many [[rock]]y reefs, which the Needler crabs would hop on and use their [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] projectile needles to take down [[Gull/Legends|gulls]]&mdash;a seabird species also native to Jodaka&mdash;or to be preyed upon by the [[Bird/Legends|birds]] instead.<ref name="Journal" /> As with most worlds within the Hapes Cluster, Jodaka was part of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], a hereditary monarchy based on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jodaka was first mentioned in the article [[Glah Ubooki's Strange & Wondrous Imports (article)|''Glah Ubooki's Strange & Wondrous Imports'']], written by [[Shane Hensley]], published in [[February 1]], [[1994]] within the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]].<ref name="Journal" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square 0-9.<ref name="Atlas" />
